name: Knight
ability: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.
interaction: Learns: 2 players, marked with Know reminders, who are not the Demon.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned the Storyteller may show any 2 players, including the Demon. The engine offers pairs containing the Demon as misinformation.

rulings.text: Mark two non-Demon players with the Knight's Know reminders, then on the first night point to them.
With the Vortox in play the Knight's information must be false, so one of the two shown is the Demon.
Minions and Outsiders are legal picks; only the Demon is excluded.

test_scenarios.name: two non-Demon players
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Knight, Lewis Undertaker, Doug Imp, Ben Fortune Teller, Eve Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: the Storyteller picks Lewis and Ben.
test_scenarios.expected: Legal truthful pairs exclude Doug. Alice learns Lewis and Ben.

test_scenarios.name: a Minion may be shown
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Knight, Bob Chef, Cara Imp, Eve Baron, Dan Saint.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: the Storyteller picks Bob and Eve.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Bob and Eve; this is truthful.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Knight may be shown the Demon
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Knight, Bob Chef, Cara Imp, Eve Poisoner, Dan Monk.
test_scenarios.expected: Misinformation options include pairs with Cara. The Storyteller picks Cara and Bob; Alice learns Cara and Bob.

test_scenarios.name: Vortox forces the Demon in
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Knight, Marianna Vortox, Abdallah Alchemist, Bob Chef, Cara Seamstress.
test_scenarios.expected: Only pairs containing Marianna are offered. Alice learns Marianna and Abdallah.
